items.areas: Interior Seward Peninsula; Middle Yukon Valley
items.instruction:
A Red Flag Warning means that conditions are occurring or will
occur which could lead to the development of large and dangerous
fires. It is directed toward fire agencies, and through them, to
the public.

Please advise the appropriate officials or fire crews in the
field of this Red Flag Warning.

items.headline: Heat Advisory issued July 6 at 1:47PM AKDT until July 8 at 11:00PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Hot temperatures as high as 85 degrees expected.

* WHERE...Yukon Flats.

* WHEN...From 10 AM Tuesday to 11 PM AKDT Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Individuals not accustomed to these unusually hot
temperatures for this region may experience heat related illnesses.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...High temperatures near 85 degrees expected
Tuesday and Wednesday during the afternoons and evenings. The
warmest temperatures are expected between 1 PM and 10 PM AKDT.
items.instruction:
Drink plenty of fluids and check up on elderly and vulnerable
relatives and neighbors.

Take extra precautions when working in the sun. Wear sunscreen and
lightweight, loose fitting clothing. Try to limit strenuous
activities to early morning or evening. Take action when you see
symptoms of heat exh

items.headline: Heat Advisory issued July 6 at 1:44PM AKDT until July 9 at 12:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Hot temperatures as high as 85 degrees expected.

* WHERE...Central Arctic Plains and Western Arctic Plains.

* WHEN...Until midnight AKDT Wednesday night.

* IMPACTS...Individuals not accustomed to these unusually hot
temperatures for this region may experience heat related illnesses.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...High temperatures up to 85 degrees expected
Monday through Wednesday during the afternoons and evenings. The
warmest temperatures are expected between 4 PM and 11 PM AKDT.
